description: She wears a floor length plum and cream layered dress with broad gold patterned vertical panels, cuff edging and hem borders. A matching plum mantle drapes from two round shoulder clasps and down one side. Cream full length undersleeves reach her wrists, and a wide decorated belt with a central red jewel gathers the waist. A soft square neckline lies near the collarbones. Her hands rest together at her waist; the opaque skirt closes over both legs and small dark decorated shoes show below the hem. Her head is bare.
